title: A Noetherian space has finitely many open connected components
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space in which every ascending chain of open subsets stabilizes. A connected component means a maximal nonempty connected subset, with connectedness as in [def-weil-connected-scheme]. Then the set of connected components of $X$ is finite, and each connected component is open in $X$. The empty space is allowed and has no connected components.
